tldr: Anthropic answered Zhipu's GLM-5.3-Flash price undercut with a 75% cache-price cut on Fable/Mythos 5.1 in early September. On Sep 22 Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI answered within about an hour with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, turning the pricing skirmish into a same-day flagship race.
whats_new: On Sep 24-25 Anthropic doubled down on its own rollout, framing Opus 5.5 as built for longer, higher-context coding sessions and publishing per-task cost guidance for Claude Code.
why_it_matters: Opus 5.5's AWS Bedrock availability, the 40-50% board-wide price cuts, and Anthropic's own per-task cost breakdown all change the per-token math you pinned evals to last week -- and the longer-context framing suggests session length, not just token price, is now part of the cost model.

status.detail: Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna's same-day launch escalated into board-wide 40-50% price cuts by Sep 23; Anthropic has since published AWS availability, longer-context coding rationale, and per-task cost guidance for Opus 5.5.

beats.headline: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5; OpenAI answers within the hour with GPT-6 Sol and Luna
beats.summary: Same-day flagship releases from both labs, framed as a new price war rather than a one-off launch.

beats.headline: Opus 5.5 lands on AWS Bedrock, then Anthropic details its longer-context coding design and per-task costs
beats.summary: Anthropic followed the launch with AWS availability, a design rationale built around longer coding sessions, and a guide to what a Claude Code task actually costs and which settings move the bill.

beats.headline: Everybody cuts prices 40-50% in Opus 5.5's wake

open_questions: Do Claude Opus 5.5's and GPT-6 Sol/Luna's posted prices actually beat GLM-5.3-Flash's domestic-chip pricing, or just each other?
Which labs specifically matched the 40-50% cut, and does actual per-task cost (per AWS's guidance) net out cheaper despite Opus 5.5's higher list price?
take_for_builders: Re-run your Claude vs. GPT cost model against Opus 5.5's AWS Bedrock pricing and the newly-cut competitor rates, and check Anthropic's per-task cost guidance against your own Claude Code session lengths before assuming last week's per-token numbers still hold.
